# SaReGaMidi Copilot instructions

Start with the [repository agent instructions](../AGENTS.md). Read the [coding style](../docs/development/CODING_STYLE.md) and [project memory](../docs/development/PROJECT_MEMORY.md) before changing code.

This is a Windows C# project for Bhatkhande notation and separate melody and theka MIDI tracks. Keep UI changes focused on presentation and interaction. Follow the documented boundaries for musical data and MIDI export.
